summary: Generalize semantic identity discovery beyond Git repositories and add a reusable abstraction-boundary check for accidental environment coupling.
reason: Version 0.1.10 correctly made identity discovery evidence-led and non-authoritative, but the semantic capability was unnecessarily framed around Git repositories. That coupling was an implementation-context assumption rather than a functional requirement. This correction separates medium-independent identity semantics from repository-specific evidence and enforcement, renames the semantic module/evaluation accordingly, adds deterministic path/boundary regression coverage, and strengthens Structural Optimization so future reviews challenge unnecessary platform, storage, domain, artifact-type, or vendor coupling while preserving environment-specific mechanisms whose correctness actually depends on that environment.
